wording: sunlit polar terrain is terrain where the criterion's proponents do not claim ice. It is NOT a proven ice-free null: subsurface ice can be thermally stable outside PSRs. These are real-data comparisons, not false-positive rates.
psr_mask: LOLA LPSR_75S_120M_201608, nearest neighbour at each cell's interpolated position

discs.rule: square lattice in polar-stereographic x, y; each disc keeps its n_F2 signal cells nearest the centre; discs with fewer dropped

comparison.flag: THE REAL SUNLIT RATE DIFFERS FROM THE SIMULATION BY MORE THAN 3 MC SE PLUS THE WILSON HALF-WIDTH

mantel_haenszel_inside_vs_outside.exposure: inside PSR (shadowed) against outside (sunlit); mixed excluded

logistic_fires.fit: IRLS, SEs from the inverse Fisher information

pairwise_overlap.note: discs are formed by assigning each signal cell to its nearest lattice centre and keeping cells within one radius, so no cell can belong to two discs; checked on the cached sunlit and PSR cells by position
